correctness.rationale: Normalized disk Bergman kernel Gram inversion yields the exact rational F(t,c). The denominator stays positive, F extends continuously to the compact parameter rectangle, and exact angular-boundary extrema are each < 1/8 while an interior rational value is > 1/8. Reproducible rational derivative resultants, elimination ideals and Sturm isolation give exactly one admissible interior stationary pair; hence this pair is the unique global maximizer up to symmetries. Standalone exact symbolic replay of all decisive equalities passed. Numerical decimals are not substituted for infinite proof.

value.rationale: Equal evaluation norm fixes a mathematically natural balanced two-measurement geometry without arbitrarily imposing a radius. The jointly optimized angular separation and radius yield a nontrivial non-cardinal, nonantipodal optimum, an exact quartic parameter and a sharp recoverable-energy benchmark for a basic quadratic monomial. Uniqueness, collision-boundary distinction and exact global proof make the result substantively more than a routine projection calculation, although the scope is deliberately two kernels in one space.
